<translate>
'''Mr. Popo''' is found in two places: at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], where he cuts your hair, and in the entry building of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]], where he trains you and runs the '''Rhythm''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He teaches no skills and has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
* At [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]], near the world spawn, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Dende|Dende]].
* In the entry building of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]], reached through the portal at the Lookout.
</translate>

<translate>
== Services ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Haircut''' (outside the Time Chamber): opens the hair editor. Only characters with hair get this option. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Character Customization|Character Customization]].
* '''Train''' (only inside the Time Chamber): '''Shadow Clone''' spawns a Shadow Dummy copy of you to spar with, or play the '''Rhythm''' minigame.
</translate>

<translate>
== Training ==
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
'''Rhythm''' is a four-lane rhythm game: press the keys as each note crosses the hit line and hold the long notes. Play it from Mr. Popo inside the Time Chamber 3 times reaching level 5 to learn it; after that you can replay it from the Minigames tab of your menu, and starting it from Mr. Popo pays a +25% mentor bonus.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 46, ''Training at the Lookout'': give Mr. Popo 5 Emeralds.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 6, ''Provisions for the Lookout'': give Mr. Popo 6 Cooked Dino Meat.
</translate>
